نرتعش (form VIII)
# نَرْتَعِشُ (nartaʕišu) /nar.ta.ʕi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# نَرْتَعِشَ (nartaʕiša) /nar.ta.ʕi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# نَرْتَعِشْ (nartaʕiš) /nar.ta.ʕiʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
